messages.author: 280d12e77bf87e28
messages.subject: Deducer/JavaGD installation error
parts:
Hello, I'm hoping someone might be able to help resolve an error I am
getting when I try to follow the installation instructions for
Deducer. I can run R and RStudio without problems, but when installing
JGR package (prior to the Deducer package, as instructed), the
following error is generated:

Loading required package: JavaGD
Error in library.dynam("WinRegistry", pkgname, libname) :
DLL 'WinRegistry' not found: maybe not installed for this
architecture?
Error: package 'JavaGD' could not be loaded
Error in search()[[pos]] : subscript out of bounds

I am running R 2.13.0 (64-bit) on a Windows 7 Business Edition
machine.

I tried searching the CRAN R help section but couldn't find anything
that appeared to be directly related. Any help clearing this up so I
can install JGR/Deducer would be greatly appreciated.

messages.author: 280d12e77bf87e28
messages.subject: Re: Deducer/JavaGD installation error
parts:
For anyone else with a similar problem that might find this thread, I
was able to get everything working in the 64-bit R version after the
following:

delete the "JavaGD" directory under the "library" directory under the
R program directory
then, from within R, running the following:
install.packages("JavaGD",,"http://rforge.net")
then download the latest version of the JGR program for 64-bit R
(JGR-1_62-x64.exe, also available from rforge.net)

Apparently, CRAN has bad version of the JavaGD package that doesn't
install correctly for 64-bit R if you try to install it from CRAN
(either directly or via the JGR package installation).

Once I was able to get JavaGD working, I can run JGR and Deducer just
fine under 64-bit R.

Brian
